name: preserve_integer
source:
PROCEDURE Main()
LOCAL a := {1,2}
? a[1]
a[2] /= 5
? a[1],a[2],ValType(a[1]),ValType(a[2])
RETURN

name: replace_types
source:
PROCEDURE Main()
LOCAL a := {1}
a[1] /= 5
? a[1]
a[1] := 7
? a[1]
a[1] := 7.00
? a[1]
RETURN

name: growth_nil
source:
PROCEDURE Main()
LOCAL a := {1}
a[1] /= 5
ASize(a,3)
? a[1],a[2],a[3]
a[2] := 4.5
? a[2]
RETURN

name: parameter_mutation
source:
PROCEDURE Main()
LOCAL a := {4}
change(a)
? a[1]
RETURN
PROCEDURE change(a)
a[1] /= 5
RETURN

name: return_array
source:
PROCEDURE Main()
LOCAL a := make()
? a[1]
RETURN
FUNCTION make()
LOCAL a := {4}
a[1] /= 5
RETURN a
RETURN

name: alias_visible
source:
PROCEDURE Main()
LOCAL a := {4}
LOCAL b := a
a[1] /= 5
? a[1],b[1]
RETURN

name: overflow
source:
PROCEDURE Main()
LOCAL a := {9223372036854775807}
a[1] += 1
? ValType(a[1]),a[1]
RETURN

name: fraction_width
source:
PROCEDURE Main()
LOCAL a := {1.2300,2}
? a[1]
a[1] += a[2]
? a[1]
a[1] *= 1.20
? a[1]
RETURN

name: index_rhs_order
source:
PROCEDURE Main()
LOCAL a := {10,20,30}
LOCAL n := 0
? a[++n] += bump(@n)
? n,a[1],a[2]
RETURN
FUNCTION bump(n)
n++
RETURN 5
RETURN

name: zero_divisor
source:
PROCEDURE Main()
LOCAL a := {1}
a[1] %= 0
? a[1]
RETURN
